audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Zed/Skill/Skill while the content layer and the packet both read Akshan/Skill/Skill/Skill/Zed/Zed/Zed — rows 0, 5 and 6 disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Avengerang hits on the way out and the way back and his passive shields on every third hit, which owns level 1; from first item on he has no dash off a marked target, so Death Mark keeps converting.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side=Akshan (why rewritten to match), phases[5].side=Zed, phases[6].side=Zed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose was the generic 'first item makes marks lethal through answers' with no reference to Akshan's actual answer.
audit.why: His only escape is Heroic Swing at 18s falling to 12s; his defensive layer is the passive shield on every third hit.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes now names the spent swing and the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were absent. Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure hit, so the wave screens it. Heroic Swing is knocked off by collision with champions or terrain, so a shadow in his flight path ends the escape. Going Rogue is camouflage and Zed has no reveal in kit.
audit.why: Riot text: 'dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit'; 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain'; W flag 'stealth: needs Control Wards or a sweeper'.
audit.corrected: Minion screen stated in breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.late, the collision knock-off in dosFull[1].d, the Control Ward requirement in breakdown.feeding.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing 18s at rank 1 to 12s at rank 5; Comeuppance 100s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim, both under unrelated titles.
